answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because jade only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, mesa is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any shale approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
